title: Dimensions - resource edition
description: A collection of Dimensions for resources
body:
Resource Dimensions - Mining worlds if you will..

Dimensions included:

- Terracotta
- Sandstone/Sand
- Stone
- Deepslate
- Andesite
- Granite
- Diorite
- Dripstone
- Tuff
- Clay
- Gravel
- Mud

Each Dimensions is purely generated of those Blocks, serving as an endless reservoir of each kind.

But what you do with it.... ! Let's Play Minecraft! :) 



Recipe for the Portal Wand

![portal wand recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/97dbe23b44bc6ab1e4ad5af387b29c7c0de2cd44.png)
For each portal you have to craft 1 block of the dimension for example Sandstone with the Portal Wand in a crafting gridas a result you get a tailored Portal Wand for that dimension!

Each Dimensions has a fixed time at 6000 (noon)

Portals are constructed of the material the dimension is, eg, stone needs stone

sandstone/sand needs Sandstone, tuff needs tuff.

Only the Gravel portal is made of cobble (stupid gravity :D)

Portals follow normal portal rules, min size 4x5(outside) up to 23x23

Ignite the portal with the portal wand and hop in!
